Fonts used by the slideshow page and the phone controls, served from the Pi (nothing is loaded from
the internet). Latin subsets, variable weight, from the Fontsource packages, version 5.3.0:
@fontsource-variable/inter, @fontsource-variable/fraunces, @fontsource-variable/oswald.
All three are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (the LICENSE-*.txt files beside them).
